text: Card stolen or lost policy: if a card payment is reported stolen or lost, block the card, notify the customer, and hold the transaction for card risk review.
UPI phishing and collect request fraud policy: unexpected UPI collect requests and phishing links require upi risk team verification and temporary hold.
High value new device purchase policy: purchases above threshold from a new device need merchant ops verification and account age check.
Account takeover night transaction policy: night time logins from new locations indicate possible account takeover; escalate to customer care and hold.
Merchant refund and chargeback abuse policy: repeated refunds and chargeback filings need merchant ops audit and transaction hold.
Travel ticket cancellation fraud policy: bulk travel bookings with quick cancellations require merchant ops review and block if fraudulent.
